name: analytics
title_zh: 数据不出库，在 Teradata 里直接跑完统计与建
tagline_zh: 几亿行导进 pandas 就 OOM、抽样又失真？它把 ClearScape 的 TD_* 函数和 BYOM 评分…
tagline_en: Stop exporting millions of rows to pandas. Run ClearScape TD_* transforms, profiling, training and BYOM scoring.
desc_en: Use when the user wants to run analytics, statistics, feature engineering or machine-learning scoring inside Teradata Vantage rather than exporting rows to pandas or a notebook - the in-database ClearScape TD_* functions for transformation, profiling, model training and prediction, and the BYOM path for scoring an ONNX, PMML, H2O or Dataiku model on data that never leaves the database.
why_zh: 把特征工程、剖析、训练、预测都翻译成库内 SQL 调用，省掉导出与回灌两段搬运，也绕开抽样带来的偏差。
why_en: Translates feature engineering, profiling, training and scoring into in-database SQL calls, cutting both the export and the.
limit_zh: 只对 Teradata Vantage 且已装 ClearScape 的库有效，别的数据库连不上。
limit_en: Teradata Vantage with ClearScape only; other databases won't connect. BYOM accepts only ONNX, PMML, H2O or Dataiku models — convert sklearn pickles.
title_en: Run stats and ML inside Teradata, no data export
